subtitle: Retail Rx — NET of rebates (~$200B rebates/discounts net out; gross list ~$700B+)  ·  CMS NHE Table 16 / PhRMA / SEC 10-Ks

hi_pharma_claims.label: Private insurance + MA-PD + MCO Rx claims
hi_pharma_claims.note: Commercial PHI ~$160B (37.0%) + MA-PD and Medicaid MCO pharmacy-benefit passthrough

medicare_pharma_partd.label: Medicare Part D (FFS retail)
medicare_pharma_partd.note: Total Medicare Rx incl. MA-PD & physician-administered Part B drugs ~$144B = 33.3% of retail Rx

medicaid_pharma_ffs.label: Medicaid Rx (FFS, net of rebates)
medicaid_pharma_ffs.note: Total Medicaid Rx incl. MCO ~$52B = 12.0%; net of substantial Medicaid statutory rebates

ind_pharma_oop.label: Out-of-pocket (copays, uninsured)
ind_pharma_oop.note: 12.8% of retail Rx; CMS NHE Table 16 ~$55B

pharma_workers_labor.label: Labor — R&D, manufacturing, SG&A staff
pharma_workers_labor.note: Incl. ~$102B US R&D (PhRMA 2024: member companies $101.6B); clinical trials, drug discovery, sales force, market access

pharma_suppliers_nonlabor.label: Non-labor — COGS, distribution, materials
pharma_suppliers_nonlabor.note: Manufacturing COGS ~25% of net revenue (generics ~50%, biologics lower); wholesaler / PBM / pharmacy distribution ~5%

pharma_capital_margin.label: Net profit (after tax) → capital markets
pharma_capital_margin.note: Retained earnings, dividends, buybacks; ~13-14% of net revenue after corporate income tax

pharma_fed_tax.label: Corporate income tax → Taxes
pharma_fed_tax.note: ~23% effective on pre-tax surplus; carved from the margin so the node total is conserved

checks.note: CMS NHE Table 16 net retail Rx = $433B; model traces $383B of payer flows — gap ≈ other payers (VA/DoD ~$21B) + basis. Excludes hospital-administered Rx (~$80B+).
Net profit + corporate tax (pre-tax surplus) ÷ NHE net retail Rx $433B; industry avg 15-22%, top-20 median ~18%.
